{{- /* creator/site-model-global.html — site-wide node model for creator (arch/26 §1). Input: any page (for .Site). Output: JSON array (via return). Foundry caches partials whose name contains "global" for the whole build, so this runs once per site. Callers go through creator/nodes.html (Scratch cache). Node fields: slug, parent, top (first path segment), title, hasTitle, url, desc, wg (0 = weighted, 1 = unweighted), w, t (lower title), date (YYYY-MM-DD, from .Date — engine: date > mtime; M3 adds created), dateText ("Jan 2, 2006"), hasDate (frontmatter date or created present), fdate / fdateText (date parsed from a YYYY-MM-DD file name, used only inside streams), growth (seedling|budding|evergreen), tags [], cover (resolved URL or ""), featured, layout, icon, base (file base name), g (0 = folder, 1 = note), n (folders: descendant note count), stream (folders), sec (title of the top-level folder; "" for root notes). Same collection rule as jasper's folder model: RegularPages first so a folder's index.md wins over the generated section page with the same slug. */ -}} {{- $page := . -}} {{- $raw := slice -}} {{- $seen := dict -}} {{- $parentSet := dict -}} {{- $dateRE := "^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{8}|[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}-W[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日)" -}} {{- range $coll := slice $page.Site.RegularPages $page.Site.Pages -}} {{- range $coll -}} {{- if and (not .IsHome) (ne .Kind "taxonomy") (ne .Kind "term") -}} {{- $slug := partial "page-slug.html" . -}} {{- $skip := or (eq $slug "index") (eq $slug "tags") (eq $slug "categories") (strings.HasPrefix $slug "tags/") (strings.HasPrefix $slug "categories/") (index $seen $slug) -}} {{- if not $skip -}} {{- $seen = merge $seen (dict $slug true) -}} {{- $parts := split $slug "/" -}} {{- $parent := "" -}} {{- if gt (len $parts) 1 -}} {{- $parent = delimit (first (sub (len $parts) 1) $parts) "/" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $top := index $parts 0 -}} {{- $title := partial "page-title.html" . -}} {{- $desc := "" -}} {{- with .Params.description -}} {{- $desc = . -}} {{- else -}} {{- with .Summary -}} {{- $desc = partial "creator/excerpt.html" (dict "summary" . "title" $title) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $hasW := isset .Params "weight" -}} {{- $w := 0 -}} {{- if $hasW -}}{{- $w = .Params.weight -}}{{- end -}} {{- $iso := "" -}} {{- $dateText := "" -}} {{- /* Engine quirk: `with .Date` is always falsy in Foundry → format directly. TODO(M3): foundry date > created > mtime; template stays unchanged. */ -}} {{- $iso = time.Format "2006-01-02" .Date -}} {{- $dateText = time.Format "Jan 2, 2006" .Date -}} {{- $hasDate := or (isset .Params "date") (isset .Params "created") -}} {{- $base := "" -}} {{- with .File -}}{{- $base = .BaseFileName -}}{{- end -}} {{- $fdate := "" -}} {{- $fdateText := "" -}} {{- if and $base (ne (replaceRE "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" "" $base) $base) -}} {{- $ft := time.AsTime (substr $base 0 10) -}} {{- $fdate = time.Format "2006-01-02" $ft -}} {{- $fdateText = time.Format "Jan 2, 2006" $ft -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* No frontmatter date but a YYYY-MM-DD file name (daily notes): the file name is a better planted date than the engine's mtime fallback. */ -}} {{- if and (not $hasDate) $fdate -}}{{- $iso = $fdate -}}{{- $dateText = $fdateText -}}{{- end -}} {{- $tags := partial "creator/tags.html" . | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $growth := partial "creator/growth.html" $tags -}} {{- $cover := partial "creator/card-image.html" . -}} {{- $raw = $raw | append (dict "slug" $slug "parent" $parent "top" $top "title" $title "hasTitle" (isset .Params "title") "url" .RelPermalink "desc" $desc "wg" (cond $hasW 0 1) "w" $w "t" (lower $title) "date" $iso "dateText" $dateText "hasDate" $hasDate "fdate" $fdate "fdateText" $fdateText "growth" $growth "tags" $tags "cover" $cover "featured" (eq .Params.featured true) "layout" (lower (printf "%v" (.Params.layout | default ""))) "icon" (printf "%v" (.Params.icon | default "")) "base" $base) -}} {{- if $parent -}} {{- $parentSet = merge $parentSet (dict $parent true) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Synthesize missing ancestor folders (defensive, as jasper). */ -}} {{- range $raw -}} {{- $parts := split .slug "/" -}} {{- if gt (len $parts) 1 -}} {{- range $i := seq 1 (sub (len $parts) 1) -}} {{- $anc := delimit (first $i $parts) "/" -}} {{- if not (index $seen $anc) -}} {{- $seen = merge $seen (dict $anc true) -}} {{- $ancParts := split $anc "/" -}} {{- $ancParent := "" -}} {{- if gt (len $ancParts) 1 -}} {{- $ancParent = delimit (first (sub (len $ancParts) 1) $ancParts) "/" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $ancTitle := index $ancParts (sub (len $ancParts) 1) | humanize | title -}} {{- $raw = $raw | append (dict "slug" $anc "parent" $ancParent "top" (index $ancParts 0) "title" $ancTitle "hasTitle" false "url" (printf "%s/" $anc | relURL) "desc" "" "wg" 1 "w" 0 "t" (lower $ancTitle) "date" "" "dateText" "" "hasDate" false "fdate" "" "fdateText" "" "growth" "seedling" "tags" (slice) "cover" "" "featured" false "layout" "" "icon" "" "base" "") -}} {{- if $ancParent -}} {{- $parentSet = merge $parentSet (dict $ancParent true) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Folder flag. */ -}} {{- $flagged := slice -}} {{- range $raw -}} {{- $flagged = $flagged | append (merge . (dict "g" (cond (index $parentSet .slug) 0 1))) -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Top-level folder titles (for card meta "Essays · 🌿 · 2 days ago"). */ -}} {{- $secTitles := dict -}} {{- range $flagged -}} {{- if and (eq .g 0) (eq .parent "") -}} {{- $secTitles = merge $secTitles (dict .slug .title) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Folder stats: descendant note count + stream detection (arch/26 §1.6). */ -}} {{- $streamNames := dict "daily" true "daily-notes" true "daily notes" true "dailies" true "journal" true "journals" true "diary" true "log" true "logs" true "stream" true "smidgeons" true "weekly" true "日记" true "日志" true "周记" true -}} {{- $nodes := slice -}} {{- range $f := $flagged -}} {{- $extra := dict "sec" (cond (eq $f.parent "") "" (index $secTitles $f.top | default "")) "n" 0 "stream" false -}} {{- if eq $f.g 0 -}} {{- $prefix := printf "%s/" $f.slug -}} {{- $n := 0 -}} {{- $direct := 0 -}} {{- $hits := 0 -}} {{- range $flagged -}} {{- if and (eq .g 1) (strings.HasPrefix .slug $prefix) -}} {{- $n = add $n 1 -}} {{- if eq .parent $f.slug -}} {{- $direct = add $direct 1 -}} {{- if and .base (ne (replaceRE $dateRE "" .base) .base) -}} {{- $hits = add $hits 1 -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $parts := split $f.slug "/" -}} {{- $name := lower (index $parts (sub (len $parts) 1)) -}} {{- $isStream := false -}} {{- if eq $f.layout "stream" -}} {{- $isStream = true -}} {{- else if eq $f.layout "grid" -}} {{- $isStream = false -}} {{- else if or (index $streamNames $name) (index $streamNames (lower $f.title)) -}} {{- $isStream = true -}} {{- else if and (gt $direct 0) (ge (mul $hits 10) (mul $direct 6)) -}} {{- $isStream = true -}} {{- end -}} {{- $extra = merge $extra (dict "n" $n "stream" $isStream) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $nodes = $nodes | append (merge $f $extra) -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($nodes | jsonify) -}}
